# Better by MTA

> > AI-powered medical tourism platform connecting patients with trusted global healthcare providers through intelligent treatment matching and cross-border care coordination.

Better by MTA is developed by the Medical Tourism Association in partnership with Mastercard and Healthcare Revolution LLC. The platform leverages Smart AI Search technology to help patients discover treatments and providers worldwide, with integrated healthcare payment solutions for seamless cross-border medical care.

## Key Topics

- Medical Tourism Association (MTA)
- AI-powered healthcare search
- Cross-border healthcare
- Provider matching and discovery
- Global treatment platform
- Healthcare provider directory
- Smart AI Search technology
- Mastercard payments network
- International medical care coordination
- Trusted hospital and clinic verification
- Healthcare payment solutions
- Patient-provider connections
- Medical treatment discovery

## Core Platform Features

- [Treatments Platform](https://www.better.medicaltourism.com/treatments-platform): Browse comprehensive medical treatments with AI-powered provider matching
- [Providers Platform](https://www.better.medicaltourism.com/providers-platform): Directory of trusted hospitals, clinics & medical providers worldwide

## Provider Profiles

- [Healthpoint Provider Profile](https://www.better.medicaltourism.com/providers-platform-single?provider=healthpoint): Healthpoint provider profile with services and payment network details
